title: majordomus.prompt/v1
description: One captured prompt, as it is stored: the JSON record on disk. The Markdown document that renders it is a shape rather than a bag of keys, and is described beside this file in `v1.proto`. This file is reachable from the identifier alone — a schema id `<namespace>.<name>/<version>` lives at `share/schemas/<namespace>/<name>/<version>`, with `.schema.json` for the record and `.proto` for the document, so the value of the `schema` member in every record, and of `schema:` in the front matter of every rendering, resolves to this path with no lookup table in between. A reader holding a record holds the way to read it. Optional means the writer could not know it, never that it was dropped: capture runs in the provider's hook before the model is invoked, so when a record is written the turn has not happened, and everything about how it ended is absent rather than null. An absent member says 'not observed'; a null one would claim it was observed to be nothing.

record.title: PromptRecord
record.description: The JSON file `.ai/local/prompts/<YYYYMMDDHHMMSS>-<slug>.json`: one member per line, in the order below, opening with `{` and closing with `}`. Minus `text`, it is also the YAML front matter of the rendering beside it — one set of members, written twice by one function out of one record, so the two cannot drift. The set is closed: there is no member for a response, a completion or a transcript, which is how the archive is kept to the person's half of the exchange.

schema.description: The identifier of this schema, and therefore the path to this file.

started_at.description: When the prompt was captured, RFC 3339 in UTC. This is the turn's start: the hook runs before the model does. Rendered as the document heading and as the Started row.

provider.description: The provider whose hook wrote this, e.g. "claude-code".

event.description: The event it fired, e.g. "UserPromptSubmit". With `provider` it says what was observed and by what.

id.description: The provider's own prompt identity, which capture is idempotent on: a hook delivered twice within the day writes once. Null when the payload carried none.

session.description: The provider's session identity. Null when the payload carried none.

source.description: What the payload declared about its origin, e.g. "user". A payload whose origin is not a person is not captured at all, so a record that exists either says "user" or says nothing.

cwd.description: Where the prompt was submitted from. Differs from `repository` when it was submitted from a subdirectory.

repository.description: The repository the hook resolved from its own location.

branch.description: The branch at the moment of the prompt — what the work started from, which is the fact a prompt is evidence of.

head.description: The commit at the moment of the prompt.

text.description: The prompt itself, exactly as the provider sent it: the raw JSON string span, copied through with no decode and re-encode step that could lose a character. The rendering decodes it; the record never does, so the lossy direction is only ever the derived one.

finished_at.description: When the turn ended. Not observable from UserPromptSubmit; absent until something that can observe the turn writes it.

duration_ms.description: How long the turn took. Rendered as the Duration row, in units a person reads.

model.description: The model identifier that answered, as the provider reports it.

effort.description: The reasoning effort it ran at, when the provider exposes one.

tokens.title: TokenUsage
tokens.description: What the turn spent, as the provider reported it. Every member is optional because providers report different subsets, and a total inferred from parts that were not all reported would be a number this tool made up.

context.title: PromptContext
context.description: What was loaded before the prompt was read — the answer to 'what did it know'. Rendered as the optional `## CONTEXT` section.

rules.description: The identifiers of the rules in effect, in resolved order, e.g. "majordomus.prompt-capture@1".

task.description: The task the prompt was submitted under, when there was one.

documents.description: Everything else that was loaded and is not a rule: context documents, skills, knowledge. Repository-relative paths, so a reader can go and look at what was actually read.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: How the turn ended. Rendered as the optional `## OUTPUT` section. This is the model's half of the exchange, and majordomus.prompt-capture forbids a prompt record from carrying it: a conforming writer puts an Outcome in a separate after-the-turn record whose `meta.parent` names the prompt record, and the renderer joins the two. The member is declared here because the document has the section; the rule says where the bytes live.

code.description: The process or session result code.

summary.description: One paragraph of what happened, written by whatever observed the turn.

meta.title: Meta
meta.description: Provenance: where this record came from, when it was not written directly from a person's keystrokes.

parent.description: The file name of the record this one derives from, within the same archive — an after-the-turn record naming the prompt it answers, or a re-capture naming what it supersedes. A name and never a path: a record can only ever point inside its own directory.

producer.description: What produced this record, when it was not the provider hook, e.g. "majordomus capture render".
